decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software sits at the core of the firm's announced direction toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management and has been developed in-house over several years, so dropping it would write off visible investment and contradict the stated strategy, even though the parallel Product B was already consolidated away.

The flow measurement automation and system software is close to the established offer, recently launched, and fits the firm's push toward web-based, data-driven operation, so any weak results can still be attributed to the ramp-up period and to the pandemic, which favors persistence.
